name: twp-cf
description: Telegram Web Proxy on Cloudflare Workers with optional sponsored-channel MTProxy upstream
author: MHDLabs (Mahdi)

PROXY_SECRET.description: 🔑 Your private proxy key. Exactly **32 hex characters** (`0-9`, `a-f`). Generate your own with `openssl rand -hex 16` (or any trusted random-hex generator) and keep it secret. ⚠️ If a value is pre-filled, replace it.

SESSION_TTL_SECONDS.description: Lifetime of a proxy session in seconds (30–600). The default `300` is fine for most users.

MAX_STREAMS.description: Maximum concurrent Telegram streams per session (1–128). The default `64` is fine for most users.

DIAGNOSTICS.description: Set to `1` to enable verbose logging. Leave at `0` unless you are debugging.

UPSTREAM_MTPROXY_HOST.description: Public DNS hostname or IPv4 address of your official Telegram MTProxy upstream. Required for real sponsored-channel delivery.

UPSTREAM_MTPROXY_PORT.description: TCP port of your official upstream MTProxy listener (normally 443).

UPSTREAM_MTPROXY_SECRET.description: Private 32-hex secret accepted by the upstream official MTProxy -S option. Set as a Cloudflare secret; never commit it.

SPONSOR_PROXY_TAG.description: 32-hex proxy tag from @MTProxyBot. The upstream official MTProxy must be started with -P using this same tag.
